statements.action_statement: No fixed release is available yet; update when Docker Hardened Images publishes one.
statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-95690 ('Excessive Memory Allocation in DTLS Handshake Message Reassembly', Low): a DTLS client or server that receives crafted out-of-sequence handshake fragments allocates a buffer for the full declared message length (capped at 128KB by default) for each of up to ten buffered messages, so about 156 bytes on the wire can hold roughly 1.4MB per connection, and many connections can exhaust memory. Only DTLS endpoints reach this code; TLS, QUIC and applications that do not use DTLS are not affected, and the CVE record places the code outside the FIPS module boundary (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-95690). The CVE record lists OpenSSL 3.5.0 up to but not including 3.5.10 as affected. The fix is proposed in https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/33620 (master and 4.1) and https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/33729 (4.0 and 3.5), both changing ssl/statem/statem_dtls.c; on 28 November 2026 neither was merged and no OpenSSL release carried a fix. Debian lists trixie (3.5.9-1~deb13u1) and trixie-security (3.5.7-1~deb13u3) as vulnerable and has postponed the fix to a future update (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-95690). No published DHI Debian 13 openssl build carries a fix. Checked on 2026-11-28 against the live index of the DHI Debian repository: it publishes 18 openssl builds (every rebuild of Debian 3.5.5-1~deb13u2, 3.5.6-1~deb13u1, 3.5.6-1~deb13u2, 3.5.7-1~deb13u2, 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 and 3.5.9-1~deb13u1) for amd64 and arm64, each with libssl3t64, libssl-dev, libssl-doc, openssl, openssl-provider-legacy and their debug-symbol packages. In the libssl3t64 package of all 36 of those builds (each checked against the index SHA-256), libcrypto.so.3 carries the version string of OpenSSL 3.5.5, 3.5.6, 3.5.7 or 3.5.9, and the shipped changelog has no entry for this CVE, while the same changelogs record the OpenSSL fixes these builds do carry, for example CVE-2026-54872 from the rebuilds of Debian 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 on and CVE-2026-84785 in the newest build. Builds published only in the authenticated DHI security repository could not be read for this review; with no fixed version in the range, every build of this owner, including those, reads as affected. Every build is affected, so the range starts at 0 and has no fixed version yet; it will be reassessed once a build carrying the upstream fix publishes.
